verdict.rationale: Linear supports asynchronous, issue-scoped discussion via comments on issues, text/images, and documents (e.g., linear-docs-24), and even integrates notifications with Slack (linear-docs-61), but there is no evidence of a native real-time chat/messaging feature for general team conversation inside Linear itself. Missing for 10: a true chat/messaging interface, evidence of synchronous conversation threads outside issue/project comments, and community confirmation that this replaces external chat tools.
